'''2008 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 5–6 January 2008, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS14]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2008 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2008 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 5–6 January 2008
* '''Winner:''' —
